headline: Q3 profits: banks lead, real estate diverges
summary: Banking, steel, oil and gas, and some retail businesses are forecast to maintain profit growth in Q3 2026. Real estate earnings are expected to continue to diverge.
why: Quarterly earnings forecasts for major sectors help investors gauge the health of Vietnam's listed economy, where banks are a large share of the market.
